theme: Cutting back: Cut down on, Put up with, Rob vs Steal...

pages.title: Cut down on
pages.meaning: to do or use less of something

pages.title: Get cold feet
pages.meaning: to become nervous and back out
examples: He got cold feet before the wedding.
tip: Idiom: fear before a big step

pages.title: Put up with
pages.meaning: to accept something annoying without complaining
examples: I can't put up with this noise.
She puts up with a lot.

pages.title: Cut corners
pages.meaning: to do something cheaply or carelessly
examples: They cut corners to save money.
